description: Election Commission - Mr. H. P. U. Laksiri of Lunugamvehera Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of that P/S - Mr. H. B. Nimal of Lunugamvehera P/S has vacated his office of member of that P/S
categorisation: This gazette contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that a member of a Pradeshiya Sabha (local authority) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the composition of elected local government bodies, fitting the Elections category (Type 7) which includes matters related to electoral commissions, candidate registrations, and declarations about elected officials' status.
